scene.room_description: A large room crammed with computer terminals. Almost deserted tonight.

blocks.text: The hacker wanders over, trying to look nonchalant.
He glances at your terminal, which displays a pattern of snow and unusual characters. He appears somewhat excited.
The hacker, mumbling under his breath, begins a flurry of activity. First the screen returns to something nearly normal, then windows begin popping up like toadstools after a rain.

blocks.speaker: @hacker
blocks.text: Chomping file system. Your directory has gone seriously west. I fixed it.

blocks.speaker: @hacker
blocks.text: It was mixed up on the file server with some files from the Department of Alchemy. People's names for their nodes are getting weird. This one is called 'Lovecraft.'

blocks.speaker: @hacker
blocks.text: Your paper is gone, though. Sorry. Maybe they could help you down there.
The Department of Alchemy. You've always wondered what was behind that door.
The hacker wanders back to his terminal and returns to his hacking.
